title: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs: Incorrect hop count calculation for expanding ring (security)
description: Line 564 calculates reverse route hop count as INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT(4) minus current hop_limit, but EXPANDING_RING uses [4, 8, 15]. For rings 2-3, when hop_limit > 4, saturating_sub produces 0 instead of the actual hop count. An attacker can craft RREQs with high hop_limit values to produce artificially low hop counts in reverse routes, enabling distance spoofing to attract traffic through malicious nodes.
close_reason: Already fixed: infer_original_hop_limit() function correctly maps hop_limit values to their original expanding ring [4, 8, 15], fixing the hop count calculation for all ring stages. Tests verify all scenarios including ring 2 (hop_limit=7 -> original=8) and ring 3 (hop_limit=12 -> original=15).
